q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of investment castings?
title: Investment casting carbon footprint per kg
short: Add the alloy melted per kg of good castings, the wax, ceramic slurry and stucco for the shells, and the melting, shell firing and finishing energy. Divide by kg of good castings, counting rejects and gating as melted metal.

ul: Steel, stainless steel or other alloy.
Shell building, dewaxing and shell firing.
Melting, pouring, cut-off, finishing and heat treatment.

p: Report per kg of good castings by alloy. The yield from melted metal to good casting is often low, which raises the figure per kg shipped.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 87,400 / 40,000 = 2.185 kg CO2 per kg
Add the alloy for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
